note: Hostile variant: selected with [[mock:hostile]] in user_message. The backend passes the model text through unchanged; the browser must neutralise every payload on its way into the editor (setContent, the suggestion text lookup) and render the rest as text. Canary host canary.invalid, sentinel window.__pwned. Origineel stays plain text: an Origineel with markup is never found in the plain text of the cell and its row is dropped, so the payload sits in Tekst, Suggestie, Categorie and Uitleg.
